text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Two hotels in the capital Riga have been evacuated after a bomb-scare report received by the police. The Latvija Hotel, the biggest in the country, and Metropole will be closed until 1600.
- PM Andris Shkele accepted the resignation of Agriculture Minister Roberts Dilba following allegations by the prosecutor's office that he violated the anti-corruption law.
- Transport Minister Vilis Krishtopans is still under investigation on similar charges.
- Shkele does not rule out the possibility of his government resigning over what he called a moral crises in the country.
- A Talsi court ruled that the two fire-engine operators involved in the weekend accident which claimed the lives of eight children will not be released from detention for at least two months.
